findings.title: Candidate-list fit chip not rendered for a legitimate 0.0 score_percentage (Agnes Sipes, re-scored Poor fit)
findings.expected: A candidate whose ai_job_application_summary_status is status 'current' with score_percentage 0.0 shows a 'Poor fit' chip in the candidate list, consistent with her Overview activity entry and Plato tab (both display 'Poor fit') and with the fit filter (role_fit[]=poor returns her).
findings.actual: Agnes Sipes (job_application 20977) renders NO fit chip in the Inbox candidate list across three fresh renders, while Carl Dietrich (29.41 -> 'Weak fit') and Emilee Hand (88.24 -> 'Good fit') render chips. Her row is indistinguishable from a not-yet-scored candidate.
findings.evidence: API GET /api/v1/jobs/29092/job_applications?hiring_stage=203589&page=1 returns for 20977: ai_job_application_summary_status {id: 7238, ai_job_application_summary_id: 2537, status: 'current', score_percentage: 0.0, headline: 'Quality analyst with a focus on manual testing and defect management'}. Fit filter 'Poor fit' (role_fit[]=poor, 200) returns exactly her, so the backend classifies 0.0 correctly; the list-row chip component drops it - consistent with a truthiness check on the numeric score (0.0 falsy). Her re-score produced 0/0/5 criteria. Screenshots 02 (chipless among chipped rows) and 12 (Poor-fit-filtered list showing her chipless). State-dependent on prior agents' real runs: only a real re-score produces a 0.0 score, seeded fixtures are all non-zero.

findings.title: Emotion ':first-child is potentially unsafe when doing server-side rendering' console errors (x2) fire once at first PlatoTab mount
findings.expected: No new console errors when the Plato tab mounts.
findings.actual: Two console ERROR entries 'The pseudo class ":first-child" is potentially unsafe when doing server-side rendering. Try changing it to ":first-of-type".' fired exactly at the first PlatoTab render of the session and never again (Emotion warns once per stylesheet).
findings.evidence: Session-1 console log lines 290-291, timestamped at the Agnes Plato-tab navigation; absent from session 2, which loaded jobs list/job page/overview but never a Plato tab. Vendor-chunk (Emotion) sourced, not feature-named, cosmetic (app is client-rendered, no SSR). Report-only: indicates a ':first-child' selector in styles first mounted on the Plato tab route.
